fieldNotes.truckGate: Open distribution center. No barrier arm or sliding/swing gate across any truck drive. The south-central driveway has only a Greenwood monument sign (no booth, no arm); the SW and SE perimeter-loop connections to Greenwood Industrial Pkwy are open curving drives. Trucks observed staging on the public road shoulder (Jack Rabbit Transport tractor-trailer parked at curb in Feb-2025 Street View), implying no on-property gate control.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any entrance in satellite or Street View. The visible structure to the NW/SW belongs to the neighboring facility, not NFI.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Loading docks run along BOTH long faces of the building (east and west walls), each a dense bank of doors with trailers backed in - two physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Colliers/Greenwood DC listing states 98 dock doors (561,140 SF building). Satellite confirms a dense regular rhythm of doors with trailers on both long faces - 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Listing states 86 trailer parks. Satellite confirms a dedicated trailer drop yard along the west side plus dense parked-trailer rows - 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lot west of the building, full of parked trailers, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Multiple open driveway connections to Greenwood Industrial Pkwy (SW dock-side drive, south-central auto/visitor drive, SE loop drive) feeding a full perimeter loop road, so entry and exit can occur at different points.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense McDonough / I-75 logistics park ~2 mi from I-75, ringed by big-box distribution buildings - Urban industrial fabric.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approximate count from overhead imagery across both dock faces and the west drop yard; low-confidence exact figure.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Taken from the published 86 trailer-park figure for the building.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is unrelated.
